0022600089.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Utah Jazz visit the Memphis Grizzlies, and neither has played a game yet this season. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Jazz won the most recent meeting 147-101 in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026. Jusuf Nurkic is out for Utah with a foot injury, and Blake Hinson, Kyle Filipowski, and Trey Alexander are listed as day-to-day, while Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart (out, ankle) and has GG Jackson and Jerami Grant listed as day-to-day.
